ids.feature_desc: When enabled, Intrusion Detection inspects traffic and takes defensive actions based on the configured mode before threats reach your devices.
ids.security_mode_tip: Detection records threats. Prevention blocks threats and records the event.
ids.risk_distribution: Distribution of Security Risks by Severity
ids.invalid_ip_msg: Enter a valid IPv4 address or CIDR.

ids.exclusion_outside_network_msg: The exclusion {address} is no longer within a protected network.
ids.clear_logs_confirm: This will permanently clear all intrusion detection logs. Continue?
ids.recent_events_tip: No events were found today, but recent events exist in the last seven days.

ids.category_botnet_desc: C2 callbacks, known compromise indicators, and reputation-based traffic.
ids.category_malware_desc: Malicious user-agent patterns, suspicious downloads, and trojan activity.
ids.category_exploit_desc: Web attacks, exploit attempts, scanners, and attack payloads.
ids.category_p2p_desc: P2P, anonymized networks, and related access patterns.
ids.category_protocol_desc: ICMP, DNS, TCP, FTP, and other protocol anomalies or misuse.
